title: Why Us Specificity Checker
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Test a Why Us essay draft for specificity: highlight generic phrases and specific details, and run the swap test with another college's name.

learningObjectives: Students will critique a Why Us essay draft by applying the swap test and assessing whether each sentence names a specific college detail and connects it to the writer.

controls: College name and different college inputs
Draft text area with word count
Two Emily preset buttons and Clear

keyQuestions: What makes a detail specific to one college?
Why isn't a specific detail enough on its own without a connection to you?
Where can you find details that most applicants won't mention?
commonMisconceptions: Praising a college's reputation shows interest.
Listing facts from the website is the same as being specific.
assessmentOpportunities: Students revise a Why Us draft until it fails the swap test and every specific detail connects to them.
